name: Project Sakura 5.2 FOSS
notes: FOSS build — no GApps; MicroG can be sideloaded post-boot
HWC=drm_minigbm causes mouse crash in Sakura — use HWC=drm with GRALLOC=gbm
Requires virgl: pair virtio-vga-gl with sdl,gl=on or gtk,gl=on
Source: SourceForge ISO — convert to qcow2 via build-intermediate.sh before use
